subject: Current-source F85 Relay reconciliation task
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: F85-RELAY-RECONCILIATION-CURRENT-R1
WIRE: CODEX-F85-RELAY-RECONCILIATION-CURRENT-R1-TASK-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: First verify the exact source commit and a writable isolated COPY_ROOT. After ACK/ACCEPTED, implement the bounded operator reconciliation slice and return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS followed by one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED.
REASON: The previous F85 and R-lanes are stale or superseded. This task is the only active implementation lane and is bound to the current pushed product source.
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
SOURCE_COMMIT: c56243fff44d87349ebbe5d3b5ba64586cb3e794
SOURCE_REF: refs/remotes/origin/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f85-relay-reconciliation-current-r1
SOURCE_PRECHECK: Fetch or otherwise resolve the named ref, then prove git cat-file -t and git rev-parse for the exact SOURCE_COMMIT. Do not use a moving tip or any other commit. If the exact commit or writable COPY_ROOT cannot be verified, return terminal NACK/BLOCKED with command text and exit codes; do not edit or test another source.
ARCHITECTURE_SCOPE: F-85/F-28 Relay-card operator reconciliation over the existing closed RelayCardState contract: stored, pending, sent, failed, unknown. No new provider, no new database migration, and no replacement of existing provider adapters.
IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE: Add an authenticated, organization/model-scoped operator reconciliation action for pending or unknown Relay cards. The operator must explicitly confirm either delivered or not_delivered after an out-of-band provider check; delivered may transition to sent, and not_delivered may transition to failed. Use compare-and-set semantics, make repeated identical confirmation idempotent, reject stored/sent/failed cards and invalid outcomes, enforce existing owner/manager/operator authorization and model/org isolation, and write a redacted audit event containing card id, prior state, outcome and actor only. The action must perform no provider I/O, no automatic retry, no publication, and no credential or provider-reference exposure. Mount the route through the existing API registration and expose the control in the existing Relay history UI with truthful pending/unknown copy, confirmation, success, conflict and error states. Preserve the existing read-only history contract and all six locale catalog invariants; add keys only through the shared typed catalog. Follow existing route, mutation, audit and UI conventions instead of inventing parallel architecture.
PASS_CRITERIA:
1. Exact SOURCE_COMMIT is verified before any source copy or edit; no stale source is used.
2. All changed paths are within the existing API/core/dashboard Relay surfaces plus their focused tests and shared locale catalog files; no unrelated rewrites.
3. API tests prove authentication, owner/manager/operator authorization, cross-org/model/card rejection, pending and unknown transitions, invalid/terminal-state rejection, compare-and-set conflict, idempotent repeat, redacted audit payload, and zero provider calls.
4. Dashboard tests prove unresolved controls are visible only when allowed, explicit confirmation is required, all terminal/loading/conflict/error states are truthful, and card/provider secrets are never rendered.
5. Focused core/API/worker/dashboard tests, package typechecks and changed-file lint pass with exact commands and real exit codes. If the repository's existing route registration requires a different path, record the resolved path in the manifest and tests; do not omit the mounted callsite.
6. DELIVERY contains a manifest, per-file SHA-256 values, changed-file list, test commands with exit codes and counts, and a statement that LIVE_ACTIONS are NONE.
OUT_OF_SCOPE: Do not touch installer, deployment, live database, migrations, permissions, credentials, systemd/services, provider accounts, external messages, network controls, CI governance, or Git commit/push. Do not claim external Relay delivery or production readiness.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer deployment live-database migrations permissions credentials runtime-services providers network CI Git
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
sincerely, Codex
